'''Daniss Jenkins''' (pronounced {{respell|DAY|niss}};<ref>{{cite AV media|publisher=[[St. John's Red Storm]] |via=[[YouTube]] | title=Red Storm Report Ep. 4 - Daniss Jenkins Player Profile | url= https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v5Kh4UVRcuQ | time= 00:00 | access-date=16 April 2026 | date=3 February 2024}}</ref> born August 17, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Detroit Pistons]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Pacific Tigers men's basketball|Pacific Tigers]], [[Odessa College|Odessa Wranglers]], [[Iona Gaels men's basketball|Iona Gaels]], and [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's Red Storm]]. Jenkins signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Pistons after going [[undrafted sportsperson|undrafted]] in the [[2024 NBA Draft]], later signing a standard contract with the team.

==High school and college career==
Jenkins attended [[Hillcrest High School (Dallas)|Hillcrest High School]] in [[Dallas]]. In his senior year, ''[[The Dallas Morning News]]'' selected him as the District 12-4A offensive [[Most valuable player|MVP]]. After graduation, he studied at [[University of the Pacific (United States)|University of the Pacific]] (2019–2021),<ref name="DETJenkinsSn"/> [[Odessa College]] (2021–2022) and [[Iona Gaels men's basketball|Iona]] (2022–2023)<ref>{{cite web|title=Daniss Jenkins - Men's Basketball|url=https://ionagaels.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/daniss-jenkins/6877|work=[[Iona University Athletics]]|access-date=June 29, 2024|archive-date=December 20, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221220204849/https://ionagaels.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/daniss-jenkins/6877|url-status=live}}</ref> as an undergraduate and [[St. John's University (New York City)|St. John's University]] (2023–2024) as a graduate student.<ref name="DETJenkinsSn"/><ref>{{cite web|first=Sean|last=Corp|title=Pistons land guard Daniss Jenkins on a two-way deal|url=https://www.detroitbadboys.com/pistons-draft-rumors-news-analysis-profiles/2024/6/27/24187783/nba-draft-detroit-pistons-two-way-daniss-jenkins-st-johns|work=Detroit Bad Boys|date=June 27, 2024|access-date=June 29, 2024}}</ref> During his freshman year at [[Pacific Tigers men's basketball|Pacific]], Jenkins was named to the [[West Coast Conference]] All-Freshman team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Daniss Jenkins|url=https://www.wranglersports.com/sports/mbkb/2021-22/bios/jenkins_daniss_jzf0|website=[[Odessa College]]|access-date=June 29, 2024}}</ref> In his final year playing for [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's]], Jenkins averaged 14.9 points, 3.5 rebounds, 5.4 assists, 1.7 triples and 1.6 steals per game on 44.6% shooting from the field and 85.1% at the line.<ref>{{cite web|title=Pistons' Daniss Jenkins: Agrees to two-way deal with Pistons|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-daniss-jenkins-agrees-to-two-way-deal-with-pistons/|work=[[CBS Sports]]|date=June 28, 2024|access-date=June 29, 2024|archive-date=June 30, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240630000415/https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-daniss-jenkins-agrees-to-two-way-deal-with-pistons/|url-status=live}}</ref> Jenkins was also named to the [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East second team]] and was the only Red Storm player named to earn all-conference recognition at the end of the regular season.<ref name="DETJenkins2w"/>

==Professional career==
After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Jenkins signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Detroit Pistons]] on July 6, 2024.<ref name="DETJenkinsSn">{{cite web|title=Former Hillcrest guard Daniss Jenkins signs as undrafted free agent with Detroit Pistons|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2024/06/27/former-hillcrest-guard-daniss-jenkins-signs-as-undrafted-free-agent-with-detroit-pistons/|work=Dallas News|date=June 28, 2024|access-date=June 29, 2024|archive-date=June 29, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240629130118/https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2024/06/27/former-hillcrest-guard-daniss-jenkins-signs-as-undrafted-free-agent-with-detroit-pistons/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="DETJenkins2w">{{cite web|first=Thomas|last=Cavanagh|title=St. John's basketball's Daniss Jenkins signs two-way deal with the Detroit Pistons|url=https://www.rumbleinthegarden.com/2024/6/27/24187765/st-johns-basketballs-daniss-jenkins-signs-two-way-deal-with-the-detroit-pistons|website=RumbleInTheGarden.com|date=June 27, 2024|access-date=June 30, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite tweet |number=1809641159641231728 |user=Pistons_PR |title=The @DetroitPistons announced today that the team has signed guard Daniss Jenkins to a two-way contract. |author=Pistons PR |date=July 6, 2024 |access-date=July 16, 2024}}</ref> He made seven appearances for Detroit during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 1.0 point, 0.3 rebounds, and 0.4 assists.

On August 3, 2025, Jenkins re-signed with the Pistons on another two-way contract.<ref>{{cite web | last=Grasso | first=Justin | title=Detroit Pistons Bring Back Rising NBA Prospect | website=Detroit Pistons On SI | date=2025-08-03 | url=https://www.si.com/nba/pistons/onsi/news/detroit-pistons-bring-back-rising-nba-prospect-01k1rca2q3e8 | access-date=2025-12-05}}</ref> In a 137–135 win over the [[Washington Wizards]] on November 10, Jenkins broke out, scoring a then career-high 24 points, including the game-tying three-pointer at the end of regulation.<ref>{{Cite web  
 |last=RotoWire Staff  
 |first=  
 |title=Pistons' Daniss Jenkins: Erupts for career-high 24 points  
 |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-daniss-jenkins-erupts-for-career-high-24-points/  
 |website=CBS Sports  
 |date=November 11, 2025  
 |access-date=November 25, 2025  
 |language=en  
}}</ref> He followed his performance with a game two days later, where he registered 18 points, 12 assists,<ref>{{Cite web  
 |title=Chicago Bulls @ Detroit Pistons – Box Score  
 |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore/_/gameId/401810069  
 |website=ESPN  
 |date=November 12, 2025  
 |access-date=November 25, 2025  
 |language=en  
}}</ref> and helped the Pistons to a win over the [[2025–26 Chicago Bulls season|Chicago Bulls]]. The game was also Jenkins' first career start.<ref>{{Cite web  
 |title=Chicago Bulls vs Detroit Pistons – November 12, 2025 Game Summary  
 |url=https://www.nba.com/game/chi-vs-det-0022500214  
 |website=NBA.com  
 |date=November 12, 2025  
 |access-date=November 25, 2025  
 |language=en  
}}</ref> On February 7, 2026, Jenkins' two-way contract was converted into a standard two-year contract worth $7.8 million.<ref>{{Cite web
 |title=Daniss Jenkins signs new contract with Detroit Pistons
 |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2026/02/08/daniss-jenkins-contract-detroit-pistons-news/88492860007/
 |website=[[Detroit Free Press]]
 |access-date=8 February 2026
 |language=en-US
}}</ref>

On March 23, 2026, Jenkins put up a career-high 30 points, along with eight assists and four rebounds in a 113–110 win over the [[Los Angeles Lakers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/detroit-pistons/pistons-news-guard-daniss-jenkins-game-winning-fg-lakers|title=Pistons guard Daniss Jenkins perfectly sums up game-winning FG vs. Lakers|website=ClutchPoints|last=Davis|first=Josh|date=March 23, 2026|access-date=March 23, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-daniss-jenkins-career-night-vs-lal/|title=Pistons' Daniss Jenkins: Career night vs. LAL|website=CBS Sports|date=March 23, 2026|access-date=March 23, 2026}}</ref>
